name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Steadier WhatsApp: a brief hiccup no longer logs you out or forces a new QR scan - it reconnects on its own (both the shop and the ASVA bot number).
Customer replies now actually reach ASVA, so 'paid' messages and payment screenshots land in the Payments tab automatically - amount read from the screenshot, matched to the customer by their number.
Reminders, bills and Send Now go out in the evening too (window 10am-8pm; Send Now and fresh bills go instantly).
Daily digest: who-to-chase (up to 5) with phone numbers, plus a month-end 'collected this month'.
